claim: The owner asked that Gravesend's sprites be checked for ones that should block and do not. Gravesend answers it by Blood's own uses: where eight or more uses of that tile, standing that way, in the campaign and Death Wish (74 maps) agree four in five, a city sprite takes their bits; it is only ever made more solid, and flat sprites (and bodies on the ground, which fall short of four in five) are left passable.
evidence: the owner, 2026-11-25: 'Check if there are no other sprites that supposed to be blocking and are not, like lamps and other stuff' (tools/mine_solidity.py:3-4)

counts by tile and stance over 74 maps (campaign and Death Wish): tools/mine_solidity.py (LEAST 8, SHARE 0.8), knowledge/blood/design/solidity-v1.json; applied by projects/blood-city/level/solidity.py
use: Run the solidity pass last over every placed sprite.

checked.how: Owner's words found at tools/mine_solidity.py:3-4 and projects/blood-city/level/solidity.py:3-4 (2026-11-25). The rest (8 or more uses, four in five, only more solid, flats and bodies left) is our policy in solidity.py and mine_solidity.py (LEAST 8, SHARE 0.8, faults() skips flats), not the owner's words; and the table counts the campaign plus Death Wish (74 maps, knowledge/blood/design/solidity-v1.json), not the campaign alone. Reworded; scope project:blood-city.
